newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia noon rubber stable after Goodrich buy.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia noon rubber stable after Goodrich buy.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in midsession on Friday after an overnight purchase by U.S. tyre maker Goodrich, traders said.
"Goodrich was actively buying SIR20 fob Padang. They bought some SIR20 from us overnight," one Padang-based trader said.
The trader said the deal was done at 43.75 U.S. cents/lb fob for September shipment.

Traders said offer prices were quoted at 43.50 for August shipment fob Padang, 44.50 for October shipment fob Medan, 44.00 for August shipmnent fob Surabaya and 43.75 for August shipment fob Pontianak and Jambi.
Traders said a holiday in Japan and Thailand, the world's biggest producer of natural rubber, weighed on sentiment and kept most people sidelined in the morning.
